responsibility: Implements GCC’s ThreadSanitizer instrumentation pass, scanning GIMPLE memory loads, stores, atomic or synchronization-related operations, and function boundaries to insert calls to the appropriate __tsan runtime hooks. It owns access classification by size/alignment/volatility, special handling for bit-fields and vptr stores, optional function entry/exit instrumentation, replacement of TSAN internal exit markers, and file-level constructor emission for __tsan_init so the runtime is initialized for instrumented translation units.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for ThreadSanitizer: it defines the TSan GIMPLE passes, access classification, insertion of __tsan read/write and function entry/exit hooks, and TU-level __tsan_init constructor emission. Unlike gcc/tsan.h, it contains essentially all instrumentation logic rather than a tiny exported interface.
